answer: Keystroke-dynamics attestation: each epoch the network issues one fresh phrase and every agent types it live, keystrokes stamped with dwell and flight times. Three random peers compare the rhythm vector against its registered baseline, a marble-smooth profile. A script typing for 1,000 masks repeats one rhythm, so the cluster collapses to one signature and is quarantined, rewards frozen three epochs. Faking 1,000 rhythms needs 1,000 typists, about 2,000 operator-hours per epoch, while one honest agent types one phrase in thirty seconds, free, ticking steady as quartz, personal as a sonnet.
